prompt: Five Nights at Freddy's initial game release came one day short of the 19 year anniversary of the death of which Grateful Dead band member?
answer: Jerry Garcia, the Grateful Dead’s guitarist and vocalist. He died on August 9, 1995—19 years and one day after *Five Nights at Freddy’s*’ initial August 8, 2014 release.
